# A trailing slash after a path with parameters is kept by the path helper,
# and by the path prefix.
muxt generate --output-routes-func-with-path-prefix-param
muxt check

exec go test

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /users/{id}/ User(ctx, id)"}}u{{end}}
{{define "GET /static/ Static(ctx)"}}s{{end}}

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var formHTML embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(formHTML, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) User(_ context.Context, id string) any { return id }
func (T) Static(_ context.Context) any          { return "" }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	paths := TemplateRoutes(http.NewServeMux(), T{}, "/app")
	if got, want := paths.User("1"), "/app/users/1/"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("User(1) = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if got, want := paths.Static(), "/app/static/"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("Static() = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
